So CME and On Call two-user isolation is still unproven on staging, and stays unproven until staging tracks main or is redeployed to the run's SHA (#057). Next action: deploy one exact candidate to staging and dispatch the workflow from that SHA (a dispatched run fails loudly), per docs/operator-rehearsal-plan.md step 3a.
